description: This file provides Python bindings and wrappers around C++ frontend modules in the PyTorch library. It defines classes to wrap C++ modules and their attributes, enabling dynamic access and delegation of methods, promoting seamless integration between Python and C++ code in PyTorch's neural network module system.

classes.name: OrderedDictWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper around a C++ OrderedDict that dynamically accesses the underlying C++ object's attributes, allowing for live updates and iteration over its items, keys, and values.

classes.name: ModuleWrapper
classes.description: A subclass of torch.nn.Module that wraps a C++ backend module, delegating attribute access, method calls, and maintaining synchronization with the underlying C++ module.

methods.name: OrderedDictWrapper.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the wrapper with a C++ module and attribute name.

methods.name: OrderedDictWrapper.cpp_dict
methods.description: Property that retrieves the current state of the C++ OrderedDict attribute.

methods.name: OrderedDictWrapper.items
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the items in the C++ OrderedDict.

methods.name: OrderedDictWrapper.keys
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the keys in the C++ OrderedDict.

methods.name: OrderedDictWrapper.values
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the values in the C++ OrderedDict.

methods.name: OrderedDictWrapper.__iter__
methods.description: Allows iteration over the C++ OrderedDict.

methods.name: OrderedDictWrapper.__len__
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the C++ OrderedDict.

methods.name: OrderedDictWrapper.__contains__
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the C++ OrderedDict.

methods.name: OrderedDictWrapper.__getitem__
methods.description: Retrieves an item by key from the C++ OrderedDict.

methods.name: ModuleWrapper.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the wrapper with a C++ module and sets up property wrappers for parameters, buffers, and submodules.

methods.name: ModuleWrapper._apply
methods.description: Applies a function to all parameters and buffers, optionally recursing into nested modules.

methods.name: ModuleWrapper.training (getter)
methods.description: Property that indicates whether the wrapped module is in training mode.

methods.name: ModuleWrapper.training (setter)
methods.description: Sets the training mode of the wrapped C++ module.

methods.name: ModuleWrapper.__repr__
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the C++ module.
